{{Quote|You're all lying scum... Now, where are they?|Gurlok, to Azlyn Rae|<ref name="Legacy 24" />}}
'''Gurlok''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] who followed [[Cade Skywalker]] and his crew to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iego/Legends|Iego]] in [[137 ABY]]. He led a detachment of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] into the planet and interrogated [[Azlyn Rae]], and threatening to kill [[Micah (Cathar)|Micah]], [[Skeeto Rawk|Skeeto]] and [[Ahnah Rawk|Ahnah]] to make [[Rawk|Bantha Rawk]] and [[Droo Rawk|Droo]] reveal Cade's location. However, Rae herself drove him away by using a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] on him.<ref name="Legacy 24" />
